`final class Registry<T>`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.registry` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Registry.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/registry/Registry.java)

Ordered list of registered values in which the most recent registration wins.

## Description

The registries of formats, resolvers, asset locators, markups, converters and key resolvers use it: a value registered later is tried first.
